title: Huntik Foundation Dutch HQ
summary: The Huntik Foundation Dutch HQ is the main base and safehouse for the Huntik Foundation in Rotterdam, Netherlands where it is hidden deep in the city, near the Erasmus Bridge.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
[[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]] and [[Cherit]] were tasked with delivering the [[Amulet]] of the [[Titan]] [[Vigilante]] securely to the safehouse but had difficulty finding the headquarters as it was so well hidden. The pair were forced to go off-route in order lead a pair of [[Silent Soldiers]] away from the base. After reaching the [[Erasmus Bridge]], the pair were ambushed by [[Tantras]] and his new students before they could the safehouse. Thankfully, Vigilante's Amulet ended up in the hands of [[Den Fears]], a good [[Seeker]]. {{source|Den vs Harrison}}
